_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Actual Budget
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Actual Budget is a local-first personal finance app for envelope budgeting. Runs its sync server and web app; open the server's address to set the password.
startup: h=$( (node --version; cat package.json) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Actual Budget's packages"; rm -rf node_modules; npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --no-progress --no-update-notifier --loglevel=error && npm cache clean --force --loglevel=error && echo "$h" > node_modules/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; export ACTUAL_PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} ACTUAL_HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 ACTUAL_DATA_DIR=/home/container/data; exec node node_modules/@actual-app/sync-server/build/app.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Actual Budget: picks the sync server's version from npm and writes the
# package.json for it. Its packages are installed when the server starts,
# for the Node.js version it runs (and only again when the version or the
# Node.js version changes). Budgets and settings (data/) are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
pkg=@actual-app/sync-server
reg=https://registry.npmjs.org/@actual-app%2Fsync-server

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
want="${want#v}"
meta=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -H 'Accept: application/vnd.npm.install-v1+json' "$reg") ||
    fail "The npm registry can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    version=$(jq -r '."dist-tags".latest' <<<"$meta")
else
    version=$(jq -r --arg v "$want" 'if .versions[$v] then $v else empty end' <<<"$meta")
    [ -n "$version" ] || fail "Actual Budget has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(jq -r '."dist-tags".latest' <<<"$meta"), then reinstall."
fi

cat > package.json.new <<JSON
{
  "name": "actual-budget",
  "private": true,
  "description": "Actual Budget's sync server, installed by the server's egg. Change Version and reinstall to update.",
  "dependencies": {
    "$pkg": "$version"
  }
}
JSON
mv -f package.json.new package.json
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed Actual Budget $version (its packages are installed when the server starts)."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Actual Budget version to install, such as 26.11.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.
